title: Drift Circuit
description: Slide a little sports car around twisty top-down tracks. Beat the clock over three laps and try to set the fastest lap time on every circuit.
instructions: Up / W accelerates, Down / S brakes, Left and Right steer.
On touch screens, use the on-screen pedals and steering buttons.
Stay on the track — the grass slows you down.
Finish three laps as fast as you can.
